name: 三方Agent健康检测
description: 只读体检本机 codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、Zcode 等三方 Agent/智能体 CLI，检测安装、版本、登录配置与网络连通性并给出修复建议。

display_description.en: Read-only health scan for local third-party agent CLIs (codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Zcode, etc.): install, version, auth config and connectivity, with fix suggestions.
display_description.zh: 只读体检本机三方 Agent CLI 的安装、版本、登录与连通性，输出健康报告与修复建议。

default_init_input.zh: 全面体检本机已安装的三方 Agent（codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、Zcode 等），输出健康报告
default_init_input.en: Run a full health check of installed third-party agents (codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Zcode, etc.) and output a health report

quick_inputs.en: Run a full health check of installed third-party agents (codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Zcode, etc.) and output a health report
quick_inputs.zh: 全面体检本机已安装的三方 Agent（codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、Zcode 等），输出健康报告

quick_inputs.en: Check only the install and login status of codex and Claude Code
quick_inputs.zh: 只检测 codex 和 Claude Code 的安装与登录状态

quick_inputs.en: Check CLI presence, versions and network connectivity of all agents, then give fix suggestions
quick_inputs.zh: 检测所有 Agent 的命令行、版本与网络连通性，并给出修复建议

display_description.en: Scan local third-party agent CLIs for install, version, auth config and optional endpoint connectivity.
display_description.zh: 扫描本机三方 Agent CLI 的安装、版本、登录配置与可选端点连通性。
